method: Exact integer scalar resolvent calculation, alpha=1/2, T=[1], z=1+1/m^2. P(T)=1; resolvent norm=m^2; scaled norm=m.
analytic_argument: For every fixed 0<alpha<1, epsilon^(alpha-1) is unbounded as epsilon decreases to zero. Hence no uniform C_alpha. Source itself explicitly prints the negative answer, so zero credit.
